messages.author: 6a6bf286a7138e75
messages.subject: Password protection without user account
parts:
Is there a way to make an app prompt for a password without requiring the user to register? I need to make an app available to a large group of collaborators and adding the account one by one it's not a good solution. It would be great if they could access the app by simply entering a password.
Thank you

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Password protection without user account
parts: There isn't a way to do that using shinyapps.io.  You could conceivably have a prompt for that in your application if you want, but anyone who had the password would be able to enter.
